peerMapping.justification: Three-run Kimi K3 consensus selected only the displayed peers: CL 56.7% with 3/3 replicate support; BRENTOIL 30.0% with 3/3 replicate support; BE 13.3% with 3/3 replicate support. Individual rationales state each economic relationship.

peers.name: WTI crude oil
peers.reason: WTI is the closest return comparator: same US energy complex, direct commodity underlying, shared associated-gas production, inventory and storage dynamics, energy inflation, US-dollar sensitivity, and weather-driven energy demand. It receives the largest weight because it is both the primary hedge and the most economically similar traded exposure available.

peers.name: Brent crude oil
peers.reason: Second energy leg: the global seaborne crude benchmark shares oil-energy demand, geopolitical supply risk, inflation, and dollar exposure with natural gas. It is slightly less tied to North American gas than WTI, so it receives a smaller weight. Its 24-hour perp liquidity is 73.627 USD millions, ample relative to NATGAS.

peers.name: Bloom Energy
peers.reason: Bloom Energy is the only clear demand-side comparator in the universe because its fuel-cell power systems are commonly deployed with natural gas or biogas, linking returns to gas-fueled distributed power economics. The weight is kept smaller because a single-name equity adds company execution, customer concentration, and equity-market risk on top of the natural gas relationship.

primary_index_hedge.name: WTI crude oil
primary_index_hedge.reason: Despite the legacy field name, the best listed hedge is a commodity rather than an index. WTI crude oil is the closest available hedge for the energy-complex share of natural gas risk because it is a directly traded North American energy underlying with shared inflation, dollar, geopolitical, and energy-supply shocks. It cannot hedge gas-specific weather, storage, or pipeline basis, but it is more relevant than any equity index, metal, crypto asset, or single-name stock in the list. Its 24-hour perp liquidity is 102.282 USD millions versus 4.553 USD millions for NATGAS, which helps execution but is only a tie-breaker.

peerMapping.historyMethod: daily-rebalanced peer spot total returns using the fixed Kimi weights; the basket begins with the first available selected peer, unavailable pre-listing peers are omitted, and remaining weights are renormalized; the browser rebases the basket to the target spot level at the first shared date of each selected chart range

liveSplice.method: current Hyperliquid native or TradeXYZ perp mid divided by that peer's matching-venue perp close on its latest spot date; available Kimi weights are renormalized and applied as a one-period return from the published peer spot endpoint; USD cash close is retained for disclosure but never mixed with a differently scaled perp contract

underlierSelection.method: highest summed live contract volume; open interest and contract count break ties

model.name: ATM-straddle-implied lognormal distribution
model.description: Each target uses the nearest paired liquid ATM call and put. Their combined ask implies the expiration distribution shown on the chart.
model.measure: option-implied, not a historical or physical forecast
